title: [Radio’ Clock] Tea Time Monday with Lee Hyein (이혜인)
description:
MZ란 무엇인지, 어떤 것들이 MZ를 나타내는지
MZ들의 특징과 요즘 유행들에 대해 알아보는 MZ 연구원 이혜인씨와 함께 했습니다!

말을 너무 잘 하셔서 내용이 귀에 쏙-쏙- 들어왔는데요
요즘 젊은이들을 👶 이해하려고 노력하는,, 요즘 어른들의 👵 시간이었습니다..!

What is MZ(Millennials and Gen Z)? What things represent them?
Today, we were with MZ researcher Lee Hyein, who explores the characteristics of MZs and current trends!

Lee Hyein spoke so well that Besteas had a good time too!
It was the time for adults 👵 to understand young people 👶 these days..!
